name: KokobeoChat
author: KokobeoChat

sections.description:
KokobeoChat is the easiest way to add a professional live chat and AI support widget to your WordPress site. Connect with your visitors in real time, automate responses with AI, and never miss a customer message again.

Trusted by businesses in 24 countries and available in 14 languages, KokobeoChat combines the power of human operators with AI automation — so you can provide 24/7 support without hiring a 24/7 team.

🚀 Why choose KokobeoChat?

  • Free plan forever — no credit card, no hidden fees, no time limit
  • Paid plans with 15-day free trial — try Pro and Business risk-free
  • 14 languages supported — Auto-detects visitor language
  • AI that learns over time — the more your visitors chat, the smarter the assistant becomes. Every conversation enriches the AI memory so replies get more accurate and personalized.
  • Real-time translation — Operators reply in their language, customers read in theirs
  • Unlimited chats even on the free plan
  • Setup in 60 seconds — just install, enter API key, done
  • Mobile-ready — Fully responsive on every device
  • GDPR compliant — Data stays private, full privacy controls
  • No ads — Your site, your chat, your brand
  • Multi-operator — Add your team, distribute conversations

✨ Key Features

For visitors:
* Beautiful chat widget that fits any theme
* Works on mobile, tablet and desktop
* Voice messages and file sharing (Pro plans)
* Offline forms when operators are not available
* Instant answers from the AI Brain

For you:
* Real-time dashboard at chat.kokobeo.com
* Self-learning AI Brain — the knowledge base grows automatically with every chat. The more visitors you get, the more accurate and personalized the AI replies become.
* Analytics and conversation history
* Operator routing and team management
* Email notifications and Slack integration (coming soon)
* Chat history export

For global businesses:
* 14 languages: English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Turkish, Czech
* Automatic language detection from the visitor browser
* Messages translated on-the-fly between operator and customer

💼 Plans & Pricing

  • Free — €0 forever / Unlimited widgets, 500 chats/month, 1 operator. No credit card needed.
  • Pro — €29/month with 15-day free trial / Unlimited chats, 5 operators, AI Brain with self-learning memory, analytics
  • Business — €79/month with 15-day free trial / Everything + priority support, unlimited operators, custom branding

Both Pro and Business plans include a 15-day free trial — no credit card required to start. Upgrade or cancel anytime.

🔒 Privacy & Security

KokobeoChat is fully GDPR compliant. We do not sell or share data with third parties. All chat data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Read our full policy at https://chat.kokobeo.com/privacy.html

Descrizione (Italiano)

KokobeoChat è il modo più semplice per aggiungere una live chat professionale e un assistente AI al tuo sito WordPress. Connettiti con i tuoi visitatori in tempo reale, automatizza le risposte con l’intelligenza artificiale e non perdere mai più un messaggio importante.

Utilizzato da aziende in 24 paesi e disponibile in 14 lingue, KokobeoChat unisce la potenza degli operatori umani con l’automazione AI — così puoi offrire supporto 24/7 senza dover assumere un team 24/7.

Perché sceglierlo:
* Piano gratuito per sempre, nessuna carta richiesta
* Piani Pro e Business con 15 giorni di prova gratuita
* 14 lingue con rilevamento automatico
* AI che impara nel tempo — più i visitatori chattano, più la memoria dell’assistente si arricchisce. Le risposte diventano sempre più accurate e personalizzate.
* Traduzione in tempo reale tra operatore e cliente
* Installazione in 60 secondi
* Pienamente conforme al GDPR
* Multi-operatore per gestire il team

Piani: Free €0 per sempre · Pro €29/mese · Business €79/mese (entrambi con trial 15 giorni, nessuna carta richiesta)

KokobeoChat ist der einfachste Weg, einen professionellen Live-Chat und einen KI-Assistenten zu Ihrer WordPress-Seite hinzuzufügen. Verbinden Sie sich in Echtzeit mit Ihren Besuchern, automatisieren Sie Antworten mit künstlicher Intelligenz und verpassen Sie nie wieder eine wichtige Nachricht.

Verwendet von Unternehmen in 24 Ländern und verfügbar in 14 Sprachen, kombiniert KokobeoChat die Kraft menschlicher Operatoren mit KI-Automatisierung — für 24/7-Support ohne 24/7-Team.

Warum wählen:

* Pro- und Business-Pläne mit 15 Tagen kostenlos testen
* 14 Sprachen mit automatischer Erkennung
* KI die mit der Zeit lernt — je mehr Ihre Besucher chatten, desto reicher wird das Gedächtnis des Assistenten. Die Antworten werden immer präziser und personalisierter.
* Echtzeit-Übersetzung zwischen Operator und Kunde
* Installation in 60 Sekunden
* Vollständig DSGVO-konform
* Multi-Operator zur Team-Verwaltung

Pläne: Free €0 für immer · Pro €29/Monat · Business €79/Monat (beide mit 15-Tage-Trial, keine Karte erforderlich)

External Services

This plugin connects to the KokobeoChat service (chat.kokobeo.com) to load the live chat widget and enable real-time communication between website visitors and operators.

What data is sent and when:

When a page containing the widget is loaded, the visitor browser connects to https://chat.kokobeo.com to load the widget script and establish a WebSocket connection for real-time chat. If the visitor sends a message, the message content is transmitted to KokobeoChat servers to be delivered to operators and (optionally) processed by the AI Brain for automatic replies.

The plugin also transmits the following information to chat.kokobeo.com:
* The website URL where the widget is loaded (for routing)
* The API key configured in WordPress Settings (for authentication)
* Visitor browser language (for automatic language detection)
* Messages written by the visitor in the chat

No personal data is transmitted without user interaction (until the visitor opens the chat and sends a message).

Service provider:
KokobeoChat is operated by Europe Services SE (Czech Republic) and Goldman Services INC (Canada).

Legal documents:
* Terms of Service: https://chat.kokobeo.com/terms.html
* Privacy Policy: https://chat.kokobeo.com/privacy.html
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Go to Plugins › Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “KokobeoChat”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Go to Settings › KokobeoChat
  5. Paste your API key (get it free at https://chat.kokobeo.com)
  6. Click Save Changes — the widget is now live on your site!

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/kokobeochat/ via FTP or WordPress uploader
  3. Activate via Plugins menu in WordPress
  4. Configure via Settings › KokobeoChat

Getting your API key

  1. Sign up free at https://chat.kokobeo.com
  2. Verify your email
  3. Copy the API key from your dashboard
  4. Paste it in WordPress Settings › KokobeoChat

No credit card required, no time limit on the free plan.
sections.faq:
Is KokobeoChat really free?

Yes. The Free plan is forever free with no credit card required. You get unlimited widgets, up to 500 chats per month, and 1 operator seat. No ads, no branded watermarks forcing upgrades.

Where do I get my API key?

Sign up for free at https://chat.kokobeo.com. The API key is generated instantly and visible in your dashboard. Copy it and paste it in WordPress Settings › KokobeoChat.

Does the plugin slow down my website?

No. The chat widget loads asynchronously from our CDN, so it does not block your page render. Core file is under 50 KB gzipped.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. KokobeoChat is fully GDPR and EU privacy compliant. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We never sell or share data. See https://chat.kokobeo.com/privacy.html for full details.

How do I customize the widget appearance?

Go to your dashboard at chat.kokobeo.com. You can change colors, position, welcome message, avatar, working hours, and more. Changes apply instantly across all your sites.

Can I use it on multiple WordPress sites?

Yes. Use the same API key or create separate widgets for each site. The Pro plan supports up to 5 widgets, Business plan unlimited.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. KokobeoChat is fully compatible with WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, LiteSpeed Cache, WP Super Cache, and all major caching solutions.

Does it work with Elementor, Divi, WPBakery?

Yes. KokobeoChat works with all WordPress themes and page builders without conflicts.

Can I have multiple operators?

Yes. The Free plan includes 1 operator, Pro plan up to 5, Business plan unlimited. Chats can be automatically distributed to available operators.

How does the AI Brain work?

The AI Brain is a knowledge base you can train with your own content (website pages, FAQ, product info, documents). Visitors get instant automatic replies 24/7.

The AI learns over time: every conversation enriches the AI memory. The more visitors chat with your widget, the more context the AI gathers — which means replies become more accurate, more personalized, and better aligned with your actual customer questions. When the AI does not know the answer, it transfers the chat to a human operator.

Can visitors leave a message when we are offline?

Yes. When no operators are online, the widget automatically shows an offline form. Messages are delivered to your email and saved in the dashboard.

What languages are supported?

14 languages: English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Turkish, Czech. The widget auto-detects the visitor browser language. Operators can write in their own language — messages are translated in real time.

How do I uninstall?

Go to Plugins in WordPress admin, find KokobeoChat, click Deactivate, then Delete. Your KokobeoChat account at chat.kokobeo.com is independent — you can continue using the widget on other sites or cancel anytime from your dashboard.

Where can I get support?

  • Email: info@kokobeo.com
  • Live chat: https://chat.kokobeo.com
  • Documentation: https://chat.kokobeo.com/docs
  • WordPress support forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/kokobeochat/
